import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = {
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-01"],
    "time": ["00:00", "02:00", "04:00", "06:00", "08:00"],
    "product": ["Cappuccino", "Cappuccino", "Tea", "Latte", "Americano"],
    "size": ["Large", "Medium", "Small", "Large", "Medium"],
    "price": [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    "quantity": [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    "payment_method": ["Credit Card", "Credit Card", "Credit Card", "Credit Card", "Cash"],
    "customer_age_group": ["55+", "35-44", "18-24", "45-54", "45-54"],
    "is_takeaway": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    "total": [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert date and time to datetime
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
df["time"] = pd.to_datetime(df["time"])

# Pivot the data to show quantity by product and size
pivoted_df = df.pivot_table(index="date", columns=["product", "size"], values="quantity")

# Create a heatmap
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.heatmap(pivoted_df, annot=True, cmap="YlGnBu")
plt.title("Quantity of Products by Date, Product, and Size")
plt.savefig("output.png")

# Create a bar chart to show total revenue by payment method
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.barplot(x="payment_method", y="total", data=df)
plt.title("Total Revenue by Payment Method")
plt.savefig("output2.png")
